parole.motivo_incerta: Of uncertain origin; perhaps; modello unc/uncertain
parole.testo: Borrowed from Norman caillou, from Old French caillou, kailleu, caillo, caliou, cailloun, calloun, related to Judeo-Old French chailos, chaillous and Old French chaille (“small stone, pebble”), of uncertain origin.
